Criteria for Approval:
• NPD Criteria above when used for gout prophylaxis; OR
• Diagnosis of one of the following conditions:
○ Familial Mediterranean Fever (FMF) (ICD-10 = E85.0); OR
○ Pericarditis; OR
○ Gout (acute attack) WITH trial and failure of, or contraindication/intolerance to, at least 1 of the following:
▪ Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID); OR
▪ Oral steroid.

• NPD Criteria above; AND
• Used for prophylaxis of gout flares.

• NPD Criteria above:
○ Therapeutic failure is defined as serum urate/uric acid level ≥ 6.0 mg/dL.
